Date: 2026-10-15
Version: 2.1.0 (upstream CHANGELOG)

Copied: the 12 skill directories under skills/ that contain SKILL.md —
benchmark-paper-template, deep-research, drawio-reconstruction, figure-designer,
idea-evaluator, intro-drafter, paper-polish, paper-writer,
pre-submission-reviewer, rebuttal-guidance, tech-paper-template, and
vibe-research-workflow — with their references/ and (for drawio-reconstruction)
scripts/, requirements.txt, and LICENSE.

Not copied: handbook/, handbook-en/, assets/, the root READMEs, skills/README*,
and drawio-reconstruction's examples/, assets/, READMEs, and agents/openai.yaml.
The skills are self-contained; mentions of "handbook 2.3" and similar refer to
the upstream handbook, which is not bundled here. The drawio examples and
13 MB of case images were omitted from the npm package; the skill's SKILL.md
and helper scripts are complete without them.

Per-skill licenses (as declared upstream):
- CC-BY-4.0: benchmark-paper-template, figure-designer, idea-evaluator,
  pre-submission-reviewer, tech-paper-template, vibe-research-workflow
- CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0: deep-research, intro-drafter, paper-polish, paper-writer,
  rebuttal-guidance (the repository license; rebuttal-guidance had no
  per-file field, so one was added without changing its body)
- MIT: drawio-reconstruction (nested LICENSE, Copyright (c) 2026 VCG-Bench Authors)

License texts: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ and
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/ (the latter is also in this
directory). The suite is © 2026 Yuyu Luo (methodology) and contributors,
except drawio-reconstruction (© 2026 VCG-Bench Authors, MIT).

Local changes for this plugin:
- Removed the "(separate plugin)" parenthetical from benchmark-paper-template
  cross-references, because all 12 skills now ship in one catalogue.
- Added `license:` frontmatter to drawio-reconstruction (MIT) and
  rebuttal-guidance (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0).
- Added short DeepSeek Harness runtime notes to drawio-reconstruction
  (use `uv run python` for its helpers) and vibe-research-workflow (the
  upstream Cursor/Claude Code/Codex comparisons are external context; this
  agent is the runtime).
- Added a `Routing in Academic Harness` section to every skill, naming the
  existing skill to use when a task crosses a stage boundary. Reciprocal
  routing notes were added to the plugin's related skills; see NOTICE.
